mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market, driving positive equity returns as corporate earnings rise over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising residential construction (HOUST) signals strong consumer spending momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1100.0, it signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a cooling real estate market, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as consumer confidence drops.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles with CPIAUCSL above 3.5%, accelerating inflation forces aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% during tightening, or Rank IC < 0.04.
